notes.title: Minor Workshop Updates
Carrion Workshop Features - Open Beta
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211428/ba13f0396fee37abccb1824f4c3bdf69bda017f5.png

[strike]Gain early access to the new Steam Workshop integration and modding features by joining the following Steam group: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/carrion-workshop-tests[/strike]
﻿
[strike]The new Carrion build is now available in the beta branch on Steam (no passphrase needed) and gets new updates frequently.[/strike]

The Workshop is now LIVE!
﻿
New features include:

 Streamlined and safer mod loading﻿ - each mod is a self-contained hermetic package stored in a single folder and doesn't require hacking/changing the base game's resources. When the game loads a mod, it prioritizes loading the mod's resources over the base game's ones, falling back to the original assets only if necessary.
 Save files stored separately﻿ for each mod allowing for fail-safe experimentation.
 ﻿In-game mod browser﻿ - subscribe to Workshop items or unzip the mods into a "UserContent" folder to make them visible in the game!
 ﻿User-Generated Content Toolkit﻿ shipped alongside the game's binary.
 ﻿Basic Lua integration﻿ - makes it possible to add new functionality or load extra assets (check out the Streaming Avatar mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2252217602).

﻿...and more to come!﻿

We're looking forward to your feedback on our Discord server: https://discordapp.com/invite/phobia-game-studio
﻿
Happy modding!

notes.title: The First Post-Release Update
notes.content:
Hello, Amorphous Beings!

The first post-release update is coming out today! The patch focuses on the most critical issues you've reported so far since day one, such as game-breaking softlocks, crashes, and so on. Additionally, there are some quality-of-life improvements made with custom level creation in mind. Not quite the Workshop integration we're after yet, but there's more to come soon!

Version: 1.0.3-RELEASE-140-gaacc44a3

Patch notes/changelog:

General:

 Fix: linking to glibc 2.2.5 on Linux (instead of glibc 2.27)
 Fix: the prehensile tentacle is no longer able to keep grabbing switches through walls
 Fix: the prehensile tentacle is now unable to keep grabbing objects while traversing through background doors
 Fix: more windowy windows
 Fix: KO translation for "Deposit biomass"
 Fix: crash caused by some controls being bound to "None"
 Enhancement: power nodes cannot be grabbed while they are inactive/charging


Level Design:

 Fix: First Flashback Sequence softlock
 Fix: Frontier - Highlands minor geometry bug
 Fix: missing ladder pieces added in Bunker
 Fix Leviathan Reef Base - Bridge Arachnoptysis puzzle skip*
 Fix: Leviathan Reef Base - Bridge Parasitism puzzle softlock*
 Fix: Relith Science HQ Parasitism puzzle softlock*
 Fix: a rare bug that prevented backtracking through Botanical Gardens*
 Enhancement: a smoother introduction to rivets in Nuclear Power Plant*
 Enhancement: power nodes remain inactive before obtaining the Photokinesis skill*


Custom Level Creation:

 Enhancement: it's now possible to load a level on startup with the following command line argument: carrion -level level_name
 Enhancement: the "editor" mode (edit_level level_name) hot-reloads the level upon detecting any change in the level/script file
 Enhancement: the console hotkey can be rebound in the config file
 Enhancement: the .png version of the "tiles" texture is shipped alongside the game


*old saves might remain unaffected
